summary: The PR addresses the issue of unwanted return type for classes when using `autodoc_typehints = "description"`, but introduces some minor concerns.

issues.description: The change adds an additional parameter `suppress_rtype` to `modify_field_list` which is only used in one place. This could be considered a slight scope creep.
There are no new tests added specifically for this change, although the existing tests pass. More targeted tests could help ensure the fix is robust.
